chunks: Aban from Ibn Abi Ya'four who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one of adulterous birth is employed [for deeds]; if he does good, he is recompensed for it, and if he does evil, he is recompensed for it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the child of Zina regarding their own deeds and accountability?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the child of Zina is not inherently sinful nor excluded from leadership (imamah), as individual accountability supersedes parental lineage. This hadith refutes the notion of hereditary spiritual defect, affirming that merit is determined by personal conduct rather than the mother's marital status. It underscores the Shia principle that any Muslim, regardless of their mother's status, can attain high spiritual and political ranks if they are righteous.
